name: storage
label: Storage
description: Read and write plugin data, files, and database records

name: secrets
label: Secrets
description: Store and read this plugin's own passwords and keys in your system keychain

name: sessions
label: Sessions
description: Create and manage Claude Code sessions

name: ai
label: AI
description: Generate AI responses using your account's API quota

name: tts
label: Text to Speech
description: Read text aloud using your configured voice

name: stt
label: Speech to Text
description: Send recordings to your configured speech service to be turned into text

name: microphone
label: Microphone
description: Record from your microphone at any time while the plugin is open

name: network
label: Network
description: Make HTTP requests to external services

name: network.upload
label: Upload Files
description: Upload files from folders you choose for it to the websites it lists. You approve those websites the first time it uploads.

name: cron
label: Cron
description: Schedule recurring background tasks

name: cli
label: CLI Endpoints
description: Register CLI endpoints accessible from external tools

name: notifications
label: Notifications
description: Show toasts and system notifications

name: system
label: System
description: Run approved programs through this app's own launcher, read the clipboard, and open files

name: rss
label: RSS
description: Read RSS feeds and your curated feed entries

name: auth
label: Identity
description: See who is signed in to Omniscio (your name and email).

name: auth.session
label: Account Access
description: Request scoped access tokens for Google and GitHub on your behalf.

name: auth.sharedSignIn
label: Shared Sign-In
description: Share one sign-in session with the other plugins you allow this for, so you only sign in once instead of once per plugin. Those plugins can also see each other’s saved sign-in data.

name: sessions.readHistory
label: Session History
description: Read the full text of past Omniscio sessions and projects you grant it

name: boards.read
label: Boards
description: Read the full contents of boards you grant it, including every item, column value and status

name: boards.link
label: Attach to your tasks
description: Attach and detach this plugin's own content on tasks you have granted it, without changing the tasks themselves

name: sessions.launchAny
label: Launch Any Session
description: Start sessions in any of your projects, with any model or engine. Granted only to built-in plugins and to first-party plugins the Marketplace has classified.

name: sessions.observeStatus
label: Session Activity
description: See when your sessions start, finish, or need you. It never sees their text.

name: inbox
label: Inbox
description: Add items to your Omniscio inbox.

name: navigation
label: Navigation
description: Navigate Omniscio to your sessions, projects, and views

name: chrome
label: Interface
description: Add buttons and menu items to Omniscio

name: chrome.widget
label: Header Widget
description: Show a live status widget in the Omniscio header: a number, a short label, and a status colour, which it can update at any time

name: launch
label: Launch
description: Open links and files, and run programs you confirm

name: firebase
label: Firebase
description: List your signed-in Firebase accounts and projects, and start a Firebase login

name: recording
label: Screen Recording
description: Start and stop screen recordings, with your confirmation each time

name: spend
label: AI Spend
description: Read your AI cost and usage totals across all your accounts, so it can show you spend reports.

name: coreRead
label: Core Read
description: Read your sessions, projects, and the text of their messages (never their secrets)

name: oauth
label: Third-Party Sign-in
description: Sign you in to third-party services you choose to connect

name: channel
label: Live Connection
description: Maintain a live connection to an external service you choose

name: workspace.read
label: Workspace Files
description: Read files in the projects you grant it access to

name: workspace.write
label: Workspace Editing
description: Create, change, and delete files in the projects you grant it access to

name: workspace.exec
label: Workspace Commands
description: Run commands you approve, in the projects you grant it access to. Checking which files have changed (git status) is the one command it can run without asking.

name: documents.read
label: Read your documents
description: Open and search everything you have written in the app, and publish a document to a Google account you have connected

name: documents.write
label: Create, edit and delete your documents
description: Change or permanently remove anything you have written in the app, including restoring an older version over your current one

name: members.read
label: See your workspace's people
description: Read the names, pictures and roles of the people in the workspace you are using. Never their email addresses.

name: email.send
label: Send Email
description: Send email from your Omniscio agent address to people it chooses, up to 500 a day. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe, and anyone who unsubscribed is never emailed again.
